title: Evaluation of the XOR reduction
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables, and let $ps$ be a list of pairs of Boolean circuit trees on those variables with $|ps|\le k$. Suppose that in every pair the second circuit evaluates under $x$ to the negation of the first. Then the first circuit returned by the fuel-bounded XOR reduction evaluates to the iterated exclusive OR of the first circuits in $ps$, and the returned pair consists of circuits whose values under $x$ are complements.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
$ps$ is a list of pairs of circuit trees on $n$ variables
In every pair in $ps$, the second circuit's value under $x$ is the negation of the first circuit's value
